sourceRefs.sourceIdentity: bestclassicbands.com|Mark Leviton I Never Loved a Man review
sourceRefs.extract: “A Change Is Gonna Come” is now of course a Civil Rights anthem, based on Cooke’s experience of racism while on tour in the South. His stirring version was released as a single B-side in early 1964. The longest cut on the album, Aretha’s take is placed at the very end, after all the playfulness and love songs, and is a deadly serious, focused, emotional masterpiece.
